message: Our platform is a modern educational system dedicated to learning mathematics for students in grades 1-8. Solve tasks, earn points and master math!
coffee_desc: Enjoying this application? You can buy us a virtual coffee and help us keep developing it!
class1_desc: Addition and subtraction up to 20, basic number operations
class2_desc: Operations up to 100, introduction to multiplication table
class3_desc: Multiplication, division, perimeters of simple shapes
class4_desc: Fractions, decimals, areas of squares and rectangles
class5_desc: Percentages, fractions, triangle and circle areas, algebra
class6_desc: Linear equations, negative numbers, spatial geometry
class7_desc: Powers, square roots, linear equations, advanced algebra
class8_desc: Systems of equations, Pythagorean theorem, exam review
settings_subtitle: Edit your details, change class or set a new password
